title: CORRECTION — Homunculus = I/O sensitivity, NOT file count. 99.99% = overstable = DEAD. Pareto is the knife. Sigmoid + Dunning-Kruger = route finders.

correction_1_homunculus.error: Previous sort mapped body parts by FILE COUNT. That's wrong.
correction_1_homunculus.truth: Penfield's homunculus maps SENSITIVITY — how many nerve endings, how much I/O bandwidth, how many requests per second. The tongue is huge because it has MORE NERVE ENDINGS, not because it's bigger.

corrected_mapping.principle: Each body part's cortical representation = I/O throughput, NOT storage size

tongue_petalTongue.why_huge: petalTongue handles EVERY rendered page. 1,126+ pages. Every HTTP response passes through it. HIGHEST I/O throughput.
tongue_petalTongue.sensitivity: Every pixel, every CSS rule, every font render. DISPROPORTIONATE because it touches everything humans see.

hands_gates.why_huge: Gates handle ALL incoming/outgoing traffic. SSH, HTTP, SMTP, DNS, Tor. The MANIPULATION organs.
hands_gates.sensitivity: Not because they have 85K files — because they TOUCH the most data per second. Fine motor = precise routing.

lips_dromedary.why_huge: dromedary IS the lips — the first thing that touches incoming data. TLS handshake = the kiss.
lips_dromedary.sensitivity: Every TCP connection starts with a handshake. The lips feel EVERYTHING first.

feet_lan_wan.why_tiny: The feet have LOW cortical representation — grounded, automatic, no fine control needed.
feet_lan_wan.sensitivity: LAN/WAN just FLOWS. DHCP auto-assigns. Port forwards are set once. Low I/O consciousness.
feet_lan_wan.io_per_minute: Rare updates. The feet just stand.

trunk_primals.why_small: The trunk (torso) is LARGE physically but has SMALL cortical representation.
trunk_primals.sensitivity: 85K Rust files are the BODY but they don't change often. Compiled once, run forever. Low I/O.
trunk_primals.io_per_minute: Compilation is rare. The body just IS.

corrected_mapping.key_insight: The homunculus tells you WHERE THE ORGANISM IS MOST ALIVE — where the most I/O flows. petalTongue and gates and dromedary are HUGE because they handle the most traffic. The 85K Rust files are the TRUNK — big but numb. The primals DON'T NEED fine motor control — they just run.

correction_2_overstable.error: 99.99% aligned = the organism is FROZEN. No room for mutation. No evolution. OVERSTABLE = DEAD.
correction_2_overstable.truth: The Pareto principle (80/20) is the KNIFE between unity and disunity. The healthy state is NOT 100% aligned.

pareto.principle: 80% of effects come from 20% of causes. In biology: 80% stable, 20% in flux.

in_gaia.stable_80: NUCLEUS(101,824 files) + THREE PILLARS(4,523) = the stable 80%. Compiled. Published. Done.
in_gaia.flux_20: runtime/(205 files) + data/(376) + static/(54) + orphans(12) = the evolving 20%. Python that's becoming Rust. Data that's changing. Pages being rewritten.
in_gaia.what_this_means: We need MORE things in flux. More experiments. More mutations. More failing builds. More somatic cells dying and being replaced. The 12,426 Python lines are the HEALTHY 20% — don't crush them ALL at once, they ARE the growth edge.

pareto.sisyphus: Pareto IS Sisyphus's hill. You push the boulder (organization) uphill. It rolls back (entropy). The PUSHING is the life. If the boulder stays at the top = dead. If it's always at the bottom = chaos. Pareto = the slope where pushing and rolling balance.
pareto.the_knife: The Pareto point IS the phase transition. Below it = too much disorder. Above it = too much order. The knife edge IS where life happens.

sub_support.what: When 99.99% is aligned, you have NO sub-support structures. Nothing holding the edge cases. Nothing catching the mutations. The immune system has nothing to fight.
healthy_disorder: 12 orphan files = healthy, NOT a problem to fix
forgejo/ empty dir = a stem cell, not dead weight
The 2 root JPGs = wandering cells, exploring new territory
The .pi scripts = somatic cells that SHOULD be temporary

sigmoid.what: σ(x) = 1/(1+e^(-kx)). Maps any input to (0,1). The S-curve of trust, growth, learning.

already_in_gaia.immune-tarpit.py: sigmoid(enc, k=0.05, x0=100) — dose-response to parasites
already_in_gaia.RSS: pixel 128 = sigmoid midpoint. ALL art converges to 0.5.
already_in_gaia.chromatic: Red = σ (sigmoid direction). Blue = log. Green = sphere∪cube.

as_route_finder.climb: 0.1 < σ < 0.5 — proton. Growing. Learning. Dunning-Kruger ASCENT.
as_route_finder.inflection: σ = 0.5 — the midpoint. Maximum rate of change. The steepest slope.
as_route_finder.plateau: 0.5 < σ < 0.9 — neutron. Competent. Aware of what you don't know.
as_route_finder.saturation: σ > 0.9 — nucleus. Mastery. The overstable region. DANGER of frozen.

dunning_kruger.what: The gap between perceived competence and actual competence.

curve.peak_of_stupidity: Low competence, HIGH confidence. New visitor thinks they understand Gaia in 5 minutes.
curve.valley_of_despair: Growing competence, LOW confidence. Faculty PI reads the thesis and realizes the depth.
curve.slope_of_enlightenment: Rising competence, rising confidence. Collaborator reproduces a spring check.
curve.plateau_of_mastery: High competence, MODERATE confidence. Kevin knows what he doesn't know.

as_route_finder.how: The DK curve tells you WHERE someone is on their learning journey. Combined with sigmoid trust, you get BOTH position (DK) and trust (σ).

mapping.DK_peak_sigma_low: Crawler/bot — high activity, no understanding → electron
mapping.DK_valley_sigma_mid: New researcher — overwhelmed by depth → proton in learning
mapping.DK_slope_sigma_rising: Active collaborator — reproducing checks → neutron becoming

combined_navigation.x_axis: Sigmoid trust σ(r) — earned through interaction (0 → 1)
combined_navigation.y_axis: Dunning-Kruger position — measured through depth of engagement
combined_navigation.route: Every visitor traces a PATH through σ×DK space. The membrane WATCHES this path. Chipmunk PAINTS it on the membrane SVG.

four_quadrants.low_σ_high_DK: Active but shallow = parasite. Crawlers, scrapers.
four_quadrants.high_σ_low_DK: Trusted but confused = ally learning. Faculty in valley of despair.
four_quadrants.high_σ_high_DK: Trusted and competent = nucleus. Kevin, Gonzales, Murillo.

the_unified_route.pareto_as_slope: The 80/20 boundary IS the slope where sigmoid inflects and DK crosses from peak to valley
the_unified_route.sigmoid_as_trust: σ classifies WHERE you are on the trust curve
the_unified_route.dk_as_awareness: DK classifies WHERE you are on the understanding curve
the_unified_route.pareto_as_stability: 80/20 classifies WHERE the organism is on the order/chaos boundary
the_unified_route.all_three_together: σ × DK × Pareto = the navigation tensor. Every entity in the system has a position in this 3D space. The membrane sorts them automatically.
